text:
nate: taking maintenance slot ms-1601 for multi-shard schema add + compact backfill. start 2027-08-03T01:00:00Z window=55m. plan: leader DDL, staggered waves with surge-cap guard, runtime pin v2.23.0-rt.

deploybot: slot ms-1601 registered. start=2027-08-03T01:00:00Z window=55m owner=@nate holdpoints=[preflight-ok, surge-check] autopause=12m

soph: preflight checklist posted: staging smoke, schema-compat run, sample pg_locks, run replica-health probe. canary targets two micro-tenants on eu-west, rate=300/s, workers=4.

rahul: abort criteria I want on record: sustained replication_lag > 50s for 3m OR surge-cap-trigger (see below) OR any deadlock >=2 in 10m. Also abort if write amplification (wal growth) > 1.2GB during a wave.

nate: defining surge-cap guard: every wave supplies `--surge-cap N` where N is threshold of queued writes; if queue > N we pause and open holdpoint. We'll start with surge-cap=800 and lower if needed.

soph: rollback TLDR (ops quick-run):
```
- stop job: `./bin/migctl stop --slot ms-1601`
- flip write block: `featureflag set ms1601_write_block on`
- unpin runtime: `infractl pin service api v2.22.4`
- revert DDL if safe: `psql -f revert/ms-1601-undo.sql`
- soft-recover: route traffic to read-fallback and scale read replicas +2 for 6m
- announce: /msg #oncall "ms-1601 abort executed, attach deploybot.audit"
```

deploybot: holdpoint created: ms-1601.preflight-ok. react with :white_check_mark: to proceed.

soph: preflight smoke passed. pg_locks snapshots look clean. :white_check_mark:

deploybot: canary wave started wave=1/5 targets=[mt-eu-9,mt-eu-10] rate=300 workers=4 surge-cap=800

rahul: watching locks and write-queue metrics. set page if queued_writes > surge-cap or replication_lag > 45s for 2m.

deploybot: canary complete. metrics: errors=0.02% replication_peak=22s queued_writes=120 surge-cap=800. vote CONTINUE or ABORT.

soph: +1 continue. keep surge-check holdpoint for two waves.

nate: starting wave 2 with conservative ramp and surge-cap=700. spacing waves 6m.

deploybot: wave=2/5 started queued=10 workers=6 rate=500 surge-cap=700

rahul: observed queued_writes spike to 760 during wave 2, hitting surge-cap. pausing and opening holdpoint ms-1601.surge-check.

soph: pausing now. recommend we tighten batch size and reduce rate to 350 for next wave. also capture `pg_locks` + `pg_stat_activity` every 20s while paused.

nate: agreed. applying rate change and scheduling a 5m observation window. if queued_writes falls below 400 we resume; else we abort and follow rollback steps.

deploybot: holdpoint ms-1601.surge-check created. awaiting votes to resume.

soph: resume +1 — queued_writes dropped to 310 after throttle. use rate=350 for wave 3. :white_check_mark:

deploybot: wave=3/5 started adjusted-rate=350 workers=6 surge-cap=600 queued=6

rahul: replication peeked 46s on replica-3 during wave 3, close to threshold. keep close watch; if crosses 50s sustained 3m we abort.

soph: one transient deadlock observed (1). monitor only.

nate: lowering surge-cap to 500 and batch-size for final waves. prioritize completing before autopause.

deploybot: wave=4/5 started adjusted-rate=300 surge-cap=500 queued=4

rahul: wave 4 produced wal growth +150MB, within tolerance. replication stays under 50s.

soph: when performing final unpin, note orchestrator scheduler may hold a lease and block unpin. fallback: flip routing to read-fallback, scale read replicas +3, wait 60s, then retry unpin.

nate: good note — adding that to release notes. we're starting final wave with conservative rate=200.

deploybot: wave=5/5 started final-rate=200 queued=2 workers=4

soph: final metrics: aggregate errors=0.12% replication_peak=48s queued_writes_peak=410 wal_total=890MB.

rahul: recommending close. no abort triggers hit. will collect pg_locks snapshots and backfill logs for postmortem.

deploybot: slot ms-1601 complete. status=success. deploybot.audit=id-ddb-4298765432. artifacts uploaded s3://redwood-runs/ms-1601/.

ops-bot: reminder: attach run artifacts and short run notes to ticket infra/runs/1601 and schedule a 2-week follow-up for batch heuristic tuning.

nate: thanks team — closing thread. will publish a brief post-run note to #release-notes with the pin/unpin commands and rollback snippet. :white_check_mark:
